name: Rapidly
tagline: Test an idea before you build it, inside your AI agent
description: Rapidly turns an idea into a Lean Canvas, measurable hypothesis, pass mark and practical Pretotyping experiment. In about five minutes, it returns a build prompt for the smallest test worth running. Your agent builds the test; real customers provide the evidence.

install.notes: Complete the OAuth connection after installation. Start with: Ask Rapidly to generate three ideas for a mobile coffee cart.
